goal: Prevent copying the entire set of unbroadcast transaction IDs under lock merely to report their count
Speeds up getmempoolinfo queries on nodes holding unbroadcast transactions
agreement: Tested ACK citing the elimination of set copies on getmempoolinfo calls (l0rinc)
Nonblocking suggestions to clean up comments on the mempool header getters (l0rinc)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it avoids lock-held heap allocations on a frequently polled RPC endpoint
Reduces query time from around 0.9 ms to 23 ns when 10,000 unbroadcast transactions are present
